 Follow us on Kerala DhanaLekshmi DL-75 lottery draw October 28: Check who won ₹1 crore first prize, prize structure, result-checking process and winning numbers  
 Representational image (Photo: Mathrubhumi) The DhanaLekshmi DL-75 lottery draw was scheduled for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 3 pm.

 The draw took place at Gorky Bhavan near Bakery Junction in Thiruvananthapuram, with a panel of independent judges present.
 The DhanaLekshmi DL-75 draw offers ticket holders a chance to win up to ₹1 crore. The second-prize winner will receive ₹30 lakh, while the third prize carries a cash reward of ₹5 lakh. Check the complete list of winning numbers below.

 02:33 pm (IST) | 28 Oct 2026 Documents required to claim lottery winnings
 1. The original winning ticket, with both the front and back self-attested.
 2. A recent passport-sized photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer.
 3. Proof of identity and residence, such as an Aadhaar card, voter ID, ration card or PAN card.
 4. A signed copy of the PAN card for tax purposes.
 5. A completed prize claim form with a revenue stamp affixed.
 02:32 pm (IST) | 28 Oct 2026 How to download the DhanaLekshmi DL-75 results PDF
 1. Visit keralalottery.info or keralalotteryresult.net.
 2. Navigate to the DhanaLekshmi DL-75 results section.
 3. Select the draw dated October 28, 2026.
 4. Click the available download option to save the complete results list in PDF format.
 5. Cross-check ticket numbers against the officially published results.
 6. Add the winning numbers to the story only after verifying them against an official results announcement.
